what: The HolyC programs on holyc.html, run in TempleOS itself. This site cannot run HolyC on its build host, so the build does not run them: it checks the pages against this record instead (build.py, check_templeos). To run them again, see 'how'.
vm: QEMU emulator version 8.2.2, x86_64, 1024 MB, 2 CPUs, no KVM (software emulation), no network
how: Put the program in a game folder as Hello.HC with a shadw.json (language HolyC, install_path ::/Home/HelloHC, runtime.os TempleOS V5.03).

gamec boots the live CD, answers its two questions, mounts the disk, types #include "C:/AUTOTEST" (a file it writes, which includes the program), and copies the terminal to the serial port: <id>.serial.log.
The play script then types a line at the TempleOS prompt and takes a screenshot; <name>.screen.txt is the left window read back from that screenshot's pixels.

dollar-probe.hc.note: The first try at price.hc, with $$ for one dollar. The terminal read the single $ left in the string as the start of a DolDoc command: $ER$ in the log, and the prices vanished.
